# MK 1974

> MK 1974 is a Lagos, Nigeria streetwear brand specialising in premium jerseys, tracksuits and street-ready clothing. Launched August 2026.

## About

MK 1974 sells premium sport-lifestyle clothing engineered for movement and styled for real life.
Products include tracksuits, jerseys, tees, hoodies and accessories.
All items are shipped nationwide across Nigeria.

## Policies

- Orders are fulfilled and shipped within Lagos, Nigeria with nationwide delivery.
- Payment is accepted via bank transfer.
- Returns policy available on request via the contact page.
